title: The build store cannot travel between campaign members
foundBy: session agent, reviewing how local builds reach campaign members (tasks/pin-on-local-builds.md, section 8)
details: A campaign member's store is found by owner, and inside a member the fallback owner is the host user's name, since every checkout sits in the home directory. So a member cannot be pointed at the store a campaign hands it. The store is also a plain directory: `make ci` leaves new builds as loose files, and nothing takes in the builds the orchestrator delivers to a member's clone.
